channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump tells Zelenskyy to stop one action during attacks on Russia
item.description: President Donald Trump told reporters he wants Volodymyr Zelensky to stop striking Russian diesel refineries, saying the attacks are causing global effects.

item.title: Hassett says he does not expect market turmoil after AI warnings
item.description: White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett said he does not expect growing warnings about artificial intelligence risks to cause turmoil in financial markets.

item.title: Trump gives Smithsonian days to replace modernist sculpture with Founding Father
item.description: President Donald Trump demands a 30-foot George Washington statue replace the "Infinity" sculpture outside the National Museum of American History.

item.title: Vulnerable House Republicans embrace Trump as GOP bets on defying midterm history
item.description: President Donald Trump urged Republicans to "pretend that I'm on the ballot," as vulnerable GOP incumbents rallied at the first-ever midterm convention.
